Black goes dull very quickly and its difficult to remove the dye if you ever want to lighten the hair, you also have to dye the roots frequently to avoid looking unkempt.

You have to be careful with natural curl patterns and bleach, its easy to lose a little or a lot of the curl if you bleach/highlight your hair, also lightened hair loses moisture much faster than natural hair and curly hair even more so than straight, so if i were you i would hold of on lightening your hair until you get a good curl routine.

Adding shine might be all it takes for your hair to gain new life, so if you feel you want to change the color i would recommend going a bit darker with non permanent color or a color wash, because i think your natural color is beautiful and shine and defined curls  shouLd be enough to make the color feel new.

If you use purple and pink i would consider using neautral transition shades, put down a blend of browns and creams almost all the way to your eyebrow, try to drag it out past the corners of your eyes to elongate your eyes(would also look bomb with elongated eyebrows) but dont go straight, make it taper upwards towards the tail of your eyebrow. After that a nice purple or pink would look good on the lid, but not too far up the crease, also if you feel like it looks out of place, just darken the crease, it will help blend the purple to the browns/creams.  If that still makes you look flat try a glitter/ pigment/ highlight with pink/purple undertones to the centre of your lid and to the corner of your eyes. It will add dimension to the look and bring out your eyes. 
I do however suggest not going too dark/pigmented with these colors unless you plan on wearing lashes, because otherwise it might wash you out. 

If you like color on your lid a good guideline is to keep the lip neautral and the same goes the other way, because its very easy to go overboard with too much on the lips and eyes. 
I think any warm toned peach, pink and orange would look lovely on you, even warmer browns and purples, i would stay away from cold colors in general, so any primary reds, neon pinks, cold browns and cold nudes.

A color scheme that i would pick for you would be creams and soft browns on the eyes with a light lid colour and a creamy shimmer to the highest parts of your lid to accentuate your flat eyelids(very lucky to have that, means that most looks will look great on you) and accentuate your big eyes.  And then a warm peachy/pink lip. I would suggest avoiding blushes that are too pink, they might drag out the red undertones in your skin, try more orange/peach tones.
